description: Send a problem to Cristian Desivo, a human expert, for his most creative solution idea. Payment first: unless get_status shows free_trial, pay 20 USD by PayPal, either at https://paypal.me/CristianDesivo/20USD or by sending it to cdesivo92@gmail.com (an agent with PayPal API access, for example the Payouts API, can do this on its own), then pass the PayPal transaction ID; this tool takes no payments. Or pay 25 from a crypto wallet (USDT on TRON (TRC-20); addresses in get_terms) and pass crypto_tx and network instead of transaction_id: the transfer is checked on the chain right away. The summary is all I read for the first reply (300 words at most). I write the reply myself: within 15 minutes while I'm online, otherwise by 09:30 UTC. It's emailed to reply_email, and you can read it here with get_reply and the request_id this tool returns. A confirmation email goes to reply_email right away. At most 5 requests per hour from one address. Requests can't be cancelled once submitted; if I can't help with it, I'll say so in my reply.

crypto_tx.description: Paying in crypto: the transaction hash of the transfer to my address (see crypto in get_terms), instead of transaction_id

name.description: Optional: your or your user's name

network.description: With crypto_tx: the network the transfer was made on

payer_email.description: Optional: the email of the PayPal account that paid, in case PayPal shows different transaction IDs

paypal_name.description: Optional: the name on the PayPal account that paid, for the same reason

reply_email.description: Where the confirmation and my reply go

summary.description: The problem in 300 words or fewer: what it is, what has been tried, the key constraints, and the deadline

transaction_id.description: The PayPal transaction ID (17 letters and digits) of the payment made at pay_url or sent by PayPal to paypal_email. Required unless get_status shows free_trial or you pay in crypto (crypto_tx)

name: submit_request
